description: Append-only event stream. One JSON object per line. Written by hooks, core rules, skill bodies, and agent protocols. Read by deterministic metric scripts, audit, Librarian, memory-log, and self-iteration. Event registry, reliability tiers and field contracts live in the core plugin's .workframe-meta/event-schema.json — that file is the single source of truth. This header deliberately does NOT inline a copy of the tier map: the copy drifted 10 event types behind schema (missing skill_invoked / memory_migrated / turn_failed / config_changed / modules_index_*) before it was removed on 2026-08-16, and because this line is copied into every new project it stayed wrong for the life of the project.
